newsitem.title: SPAIN: Barcelona air cargo traffic up 18pct in December.
newsitem.headline: Barcelona air cargo traffic up 18pct in December.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Spain's Barcelona airport rose 18 percent in December compared with the same month in 1995 to 7,260 tonnes, the airport authority said.
Cargo handled in 1996 totalled 80,077 tonnes, up 17.3 percent on 1995.

International freight business provided most of the growth, rising nearly 22 percent in the month to 4,541 tonnes to take the yearly total up 27.9 percent higher to 47,625 tonnes while domestic cargo grew 12.3 percent in the month to 2,719 tonnes to give an annual total of 32,452 tonnes, 4.5 percent more than in 1995.

Passenger numbers were 13.1 percent higher in December at 962,262 excluding transit passengers, taking the accumulated total to 12.92 million, a rise of 14.2 percent. Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax5017
